I am an old woman farming my small bean plot here in Mulanje. Beans do not need the fertilizer like maize does, and anyway the FISP coupons go to the maize plot, not to beans. I will save my small money and use the seeds I kept from last harvest, and work the plot myself with my hoe as I always have. Since I intercrop, I will tend it carefully but beans are not so demanding of labor as maize.
